title: Vibe Coded a Rhythm Roguelike
author: Dersuss
selftext:
I learned to program a few years back but was never really confident in my abilities. But I've always been interested in game development. Last week I had an idea for a rhythm roguelike where you build your own loops and use those to attack. What was supposed to be a quick prototype kinda spiralled into something more. I was shocked at how quick and easy it was to take an idea and turn it into something legit.

So I present, Rogue Wave, my first game! Currently debating polishing this or diving into a different slightly more ambitious dispatch style game. I've adapted it for mobile as well (though it is a bit harder and personally I prefer pc). Would love some feedback and curious what you think? 

Made with Claude Code and ChatGPT. I transitioned to claude code part way through, and it made life much easier.
